title: DIVINE CONFIDENCE
content:
Filled with expectancy,
I conceive glory.

Not because the stars bow before me,
but because I’m carried in divine promise.

As the sea waves rise,
I am anchored to an unmovable Rock.

Even if Josephed for silver,
my soul bears witness that the Redeemer is near.

I lift my eyes unto the hills,
and behold the hand of Providence.

Carving His name upon the pathways of my soul,
my heart attests that I am carried on the wings of grace, moving toward a glorious destiny.

title: AFTER THE MESSAGE
content:
Wandering in thought for a decade,
I felt compelled to send the message.

As a happy bird chirps and sings joyfully in the morning,
what felt like an empty room overflowed with jubilation from a whisper.

For a brief moment, jubilation made its home within my heart.

Now, the once joyful soul is fading,
Fading and fading from within.

The echo won’t stop repeating.
A loud whisper that once brought jubilation has now become an echo.

Sitting beneath towering bamboo trees, I ponder a simple truth:
“Letting our companionship drift away like withered leaves is the surest path.”

Though the stars drift apart, our radiance shall forever reign supreme.

As the morning sun shines,
our hearts may meet where distance cannot.

title: RAY OF PURPOSE
content:
Having spent years and days in uncertainty,
you now have a ray of sunlight beaming towards you.

Do not wait for the perfect time to knock.
Begin planting trees.
The habits you build today,
will become the harvest you reap tomorrow.

Become the greatest project you will ever undertake.
Seek souls that will add depth to your life, not shallowness.
Pursue mastery with ambition and purpose.
Invest in your roots so you can stand firm in every storm.
Choose to see the glass as half full rather than half empty.

On this blank page before you,
nurture bonds that endure.
Embrace growth with open hands.
Let knowledge light your way.
Scatter seeds of value along your path.

As life and death have been placed before you,
I beseech you, choose life
Not because you seek immortality,
but because you choose to make Christ the centre of your life.

And I know with Him as your anchor,
your path is illuminated and your future is secure.
With Him in your boat,
the storm will come but you will not sink.

title: SERENITY
content:
Peace, perfect peace!
Tranquility crowns the heart with rest.

The past lingers,
like bees in search of a hive.
And golden hands cradle the soul.

The memories of yesterday remain,
but their weight grows lighter with time.

Honour peace,
for it lends stillness to every ordeal.

With essence nourished
and self-reverence embraced,
the soul finds its light.

Behind the storms, a quiet garden blooms;
no treasure rivals the gift of inner peace.
